items.item: Volkswagen ID. Buzz 2025: stored starting price $70,540 (MSRP + destination) differs from Car and Driver's $61,545
items.reason: Car and Driver's $61,545 is the Pro S RWD ($59,995 Starting MSRP on vw.com + $1,550). We carry the RWD trims with msrp 'N/A - Not New' by design; pricing them is a person's call. vw.com confirms the $69,995 top price (1st Edition 4MOTION).
